name: Sami
headline: Turn Swiss’s booking data into customers who keep flying.
saw: Airline offers usually reach every traveller in the same way: the same fares, bundles and upgrade prompts shown to a business traveller and a family planning a holiday alike.

Booking data, travel dates, routes changed, cabins chosen and fares searched but never booked are the strongest signals for the next upgrade and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The traveller who cancels a flight this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Catch the traveller before they leave
cases.text: Per-customer churn signals from booking changes, cancellations and unused bookings. The right offer, channel and moment picked for each traveller, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next trip that fits
cases.text: Next best offer per customer, built from booking history, routes flown and cabin choices. Upgrades and add-ons reach only the customers likely to take them.

cases.head: Keep every trip in view, every week
cases.text: Personal messages across email and your other channels, timed to each customer’s travel pattern. Reasons to plan the next journey, sent when that customer is most likely to act.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
